The main takeaway from our work is that

the large signal characteristics and thermal analysis of the double drift impact avalanche transit time devices can be carried out in a systematic manner using a suitable simulation technique and the heat sink material should be carefully chosen for the device operating in pulsed mode.

the junction temperature has a profound effect on the large signal RF output characteristics of the device and hence the junction temperature of the device has to be maintained at a low value to get the maximum power output from the device in both the CW and pulsed operating modes.
